关键词: Financial Reporting and Audit Task Force
Center for Risk and Quantitative Analytics
主要内容: On July 2, 2013, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) announced three new initiatives aimed at combating financial reporting fraud, microcap fraud, and enhancing risk analysis. These initiatives include the Financial Reporting and Audit Task Force, which focuses on detecting fraudulent financial reporting and improving enforcement efforts related to accounting and disclosure fraud. The Microcap Fraud Task Force targets abusive trading and fraudulent conduct in securities issued by microcap companies, especially those that do not regularly report financial results. The Center for Risk and Quantitative Analytics employs quantitative data and analysis to identify high-risk behaviors and support investigations. The initiatives aim to increase the SEC's ability to detect and prevent misconduct that harms investors. One initiative involves the creation of a Task Force dedicated to investigating participants in the microcap securities market. This Task Force will not replace the existing Microcap Fraud Working Group, which was established in 2010 to detect and prevent microcap fraud. Instead, it will consist of staff exclusively focused on investigations. Elisha Frank and Michael Paley will lead this Task Force. Another initiative is the establishment of the Center for Risk and Quantitative Analytics (CRQA), which will support the Division's risk identification and data analytic activities. The CRQA will work closely with other Commission offices and provide guidance on resource allocation based on identified risks. Lori Walsh will lead the CRQA. These initiatives aim to improve the SEC's ability to identify and address potential fraud and illegal activities in the financial market.
